message.content:
Based on my analysis of the dashboard, here is the assessment of the UI issues regarding button text visibility:

(1) The buttons with white text that are hard to read are located in the **top-right navigation bar**. Specifically, the **"Show Answers"**, **"Flashcards"**, and **"PDF"** buttons use white text against a dark, navy-blue background. While the contrast is technically acceptable, the text appears somewhat thin and lacks the boldness or glow seen in other elements, making it less legible than the primary calls to action.

(2) The **Flashcards** button in the top header has **white text**. It is readable but lacks visual "pop" compared to the vibrant orange elements in the main content area.

(3) Similarly, the **Quiz Center** button (labeled "Open Quiz Center") at the bottom right uses **white text** inside a transparent/outlined container. It is legible but blends into the dark background more than the prominent yellow "Start Lesson" button.

(4) Other buttons with potentially poor visibility include the small icon-based buttons in the top bar (**Cover**, **Dark**) which rely on white icons that may be difficult for users with visual impairments to distinguish clearly from the background.

(5) A **'Question of the Day'** button would be best placed in the **sidebar quick actions area** (if one exists below the chapter list) or as a **prominent banner just above the statistics footer** at the bottom of the main card. This placement ensures high visibility without distracting from the primary "Start Lesson" workflow.
